profile.summary: Better Together Audiology is an Oakland, California practice that provides educational audiology consulting. It supports students who are deaf or hard of hearing, along with their families and school staff, through hearing-related assessments, recommendations and troubleshooting for hearing assistive technology, and training. Services are offered in person and remotely across California.
